base: Property subject to administration (commission, Est. & Trusts § 7-601(b)); value of the probate estate per administration accounts: inventories plus principal and income receipts plus realized gains less realized losses (Register of Wills fee, § 2-206(b)(3)).

schedules.who: Personal representative commission, maximum (Md. Code, Est. & Trusts § 7-601(b))
schedules.text: Not over $20,000: 9%; over $20,000: $1,800 plus 3.6% of the excess over $20,000 (Est. & Trusts § 7-601(b)(2)).
schedules.capNote: Maximum commission; the court allows what it considers appropriate.

schedules.who: Register of Wills probate fee (Md. Code, Est. & Trusts § 2-206(b)(2))
schedules.capNote: Bracket upper bounds encoded as x.99 because the statute uses 'at least / but less than'.

testCases.source: computed by hand: 1,800 + 3.6% x 280,000; fee bracket $100,000-$500,000
